GOOD TO KNOW

Tickets have two new statuses, In progress and Reopened. Both count as open everywhere: service levels, escalation, filters and reports treat them as Open. Existing tickets are not changed. A system that reads ticket status through the API will see two new values, IN_PROGRESS and REOPENED; a resolved ticket that is reopened now reads REOPENED where it read OPEN.

A ticket that waits on a queue for calls only now waits there as written work, so it is offered to agents who take email. It no longer arrives as a call.

Adding a voice from the Yaxxa AI gallery adds it on the Yaxxa AI server once, for every organisation that uses Yaxxa AI.

FOR AGENTS

Transfers leave your desk: when you transfer an email, chat or message that has a ticket, the conversation and its ticket go together, leave your desk at once, and the desk says "Transferred to …". One piece of work is sent, not two.

A ticket given to you from a queue shows as a ticket, "Ticket CASE-… is with you", with Open the ticket, Done and Back to the queue. It never shows as a call and never takes your call slot.

Ticket statuses: a ticket becomes In progress when you reply, add a note, accept it from a queue or make yourself its owner. It becomes Reopened when the customer writes on a resolved ticket or someone reopens it.

Imported tickets show their old number ("was TKT-…") beside the new one, with a summary of what was brought in.

FOR SUPERVISORS

Live, List view: sorting by State keeps each state together, with the agent longest in it first and not-ready agents grouped by reason; click again to reverse. Your own row sits in its group. Reason, Campaign, Queue, Handled today and Average handle time sort too.

End this work: on the Live page a supervisor can end a ticket task an agent is holding.

Tickets show the queue they are on, as a column and a filter, and the Tickets report can be grouped by queue and has Reopened and Reopen rate.

FOR ADMINISTRATORS

Choosing a Yaxxa AI voice: wherever a Yaxxa AI voice is chosen there are now three ways. Saved voices: the voices on your Yaxxa AI server. Voice gallery: browse more than a thousand voices by group, gender, age, accent and language, and Use this voice. Describe a voice: choose gender, age, pitch and accent, with a whisper option; it sounds the same on every call. A saved or gallery voice is steadier for a contact centre.

Import from HoduCC: In progress and Reopened now map straight across, and a HoduCC queue can be matched to one of your queues.

Reports and replies take files: a problem report, and any reply on it under My reports, takes pictures, PDF, Word, text, log, CSV, HTML, JSON and saved-email files. The reply box takes up to 20,000 characters. A file that is refused no longer stops the report being sent."}
